decl/version-2.reason: Oracle limitation: expat does not check VersionNum, but XML 1.0 (5th ed.) [26] requires 1.[0-9]+; rejecting 2.0 is correct.

xmlconf/hst-lhs-007.reason: By design: Xml.parse_str takes already-decoded text, so a declared encoding is informational and cannot contradict the byte order mark.
